selectionNote: Selected 20 guided Osaka d333 products with live public USD From prices (From$, From US$, or FromUSD on US-facing listings), combined ratings, unique 674x446 heroes, and commercially diverse categories (licensed private walking, personalized private, street-food nights, bike-and-food, cooking, Kuromon market, castle/Dotonbori walking, and one Kyoto-Nara day trip from Osaka). Did not pad with audio/self-guided/app/GPS tours, USJ tickets, JR/ICOCA/Amazing Pass products, airport transfers, driver-only charters, sake/tea SKUs without verified USD, thin-review SKUs, or near-duplicates of the same licensed 4hr/6hr walking SKU. No live helicopter, stargazing, or Indigenous-only cultural page with combined USD+rating+hero was captured. Same completeness constraint documented on Bali (12), Bangkok (10), Kyoto (14), and Tokyo (11).
